notes.title: Patch v.0.1.91
notes.notes:
Updated manual creation to allow use of abilities to show on the manually created creature.

Next update will be attacks to manual creation

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.9
notes.notes:
Updated senses into the manual creation options to display when creating the creature.

Fixed an option on the immunities to remove "All Damage" as an option

notes.title: Patch v.01.89
notes.notes:
Added functionality to challenge rating, stat dice rolls with profeciency, you can now select skills, languages, saving throws, resistances, immunities, condition immunities for manually created creatures.

Still no speed, senses, attacks, abilities, or saving manually created monsters.

notes.title: Patch v.01.88
notes.notes:
Manual creation has arrived.... kind of.


You can now view all available options for manual creation
You can now select description for the creatures
You can now select HP, AC, Challenge Rating, and Attributes for creatures
The manual generated monster will not be able to be saved at this time
Next update will feature Saving throws, skills, languages (maybe more)


There are still bugs with: 

Attack rolls that feature multiple dice
Extended delay with dice results at times
Saving is still clunky and will be reworked at a later time
Saving will be updated to allow the saving of manually created creatures


Thanks for being patient, life hasn't been.

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.87
notes.notes:
This weeks update is a small one, but did resolve the issues I wanted to cover.

 Dice results new reset when creating a new creature so it doesn't clutter the sidebar. 
 After adding or subtracting from the creatures hp the value entered will be removed.


The plan for the next update will include: 

 Initial testing of manual creation menu.
 Full page of manual creation will be available to manually select each piece of the monster instead of ot being 100% random.

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.86
notes.notes:
There are 22 unique traits currently, with no plan to add additional ones at this time, but that doesn't mean I won't add more in the future.

No other changes during this update, although some issues have been found.

 Attacks that use two dice will only show the value for one.
 Attacks that are supposed to deal two types of damage do not roll for the alternate damage.
 Dice overall feel slow to show dice results


The plan for the next update will include: 

 Clear the value entered to alter the health of the creatures and selecting to add or subtract from health.
 Clear dice results when generating a new creature
 Work done on the manual selection creature


Once manual selection is complete I will adress the issues with the dice, sorry if it causes any issues.

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.85
notes.notes:
We have made a few adjustments this last update and implemented the save function.

Save Function added: 

 Access Save option from Creature Page
 New Save is always bottom option
 Selecting an older save will overwrite it with the new seed
 Able to delete saves from the Load Menu


A few small fixes to other features:

 HP for creatures to start at 0 or a negative number will now have 1 HP
 Damage dice will no longer default to lowest possible dice
 Versatile dice will no longer prompt when the attack does not  have versatile dice
 Saving background color is now automatic when backing out of the settings menu
 Added current  HP to the creature page with the ability to subtract / add to the current value

notes.title: Patch v.0.1.84
notes.notes:
The ability page now has HIT and DMG dice options for attacks, the damage dice however will always ask if its high or low if any creature has had a versatile weapon. Working on removing it from always asking if there is no versatile option for the attack.

The save feature will only save to the first slot, however instead of saving the currently viewed creature it creates an entirely new seed to save for you to load which is clearly not intended. Once this is resolved we will add in more save slots (Hopefully unlimited so you can save all the creatures)
